sources.title: Böhm and Sontacchi (1978): cycles of given length

quotes.text: Böhm, Corrado, and Sontacchi, Giovanna. "On the existence of cycles of given length in integer sequences like $x_{n+1} = x_{n}/2$ if $x_{n}$ even, and $x_{n+1} = 3 x_{n} + 1$."

sources.title: Lagarias survey: parity vectors and residue classes

quotes.text: Theorem B allows one to associate with each vector of length k a unique congruence class.
Böhm and Sontacchi also noted that this gives an (inefficient) finite procedure for deciding if there are any cycles of a given length k.

sources.title: Rukhin (2018): dual-radix modular division and integrality tests

quotes.text: This division algorithm yields two novel methods for testing the integrality of the Bohm-Sontacchi numbers.
Theorem 4.9 yields a method (the prefix test) for deciding the integrality of the rational expression.
